payload.summary: Planned Gemini Batch API execution for non-latency-sensitive steps. Gate 1 selected Approach A (dedicated batch_jobs/batch_requests tables + flush/poll worker + per-step result handlers) for durability across the 24-48h batch window. Phased rollout: Phase 0 core infra (default OFF), then content_filtering, captions+yt-rss, then youtube_processing.

decisions.title: Dedicated durable batch tables over queue-reuse/in-memory
decisions.rationale: Batch is deferred across hours+restarts; durability is a requirement. Generic target/handler makes phased rollout additive.

decisions.title: Per-step opt-in via batch_execution map, default OFF
decisions.rationale: Zero behavior change when disabled; instant per-step rollback to sync.

decisions.title: youtube_processing batches both YouTube-URL (public) and transcript (unlisted) sub-paths
decisions.rationale: Per-video visibility selects sub-path; unlisted playlist of public videos uses the video part.

next_steps: Implement Phase 0 wp-core: schema migration + LLMRouter.submit_batch/poll_batch first (TDD).
